correctness.rationale: The Nyström pseudoinverse is the active-span projection. Rank-one monochromatic leave-one-out sketches have exact residual \(ab/(a+b)\begin{pmatrix}1&-s\\-s&1\end{pmatrix}\), residual trace \(c\) and held-out quadratic \(c(1-st)\). Mixed signs span the two active coordinates and produce the exact input. Exhaustive combinatorial partition into all-equal, exactly-one-minority, and remaining signs proves the three-atom law for every \(m\ge3\); \(m=2\) treated separately. Derived moments, \(1/2\) basic-estimate correlation and false-zero mass follow algebraically. The actual standalone exact-rational checker passed 4080 cases for \(2\le m\le9\) with four rational eigenvalue pairs, supporting but not replacing the proof.

value.rationale: The natural first nontrivial positive-semidefinite matrix rank and fair-sign sketch expose a material mismatch between squared posterior diagnostic and true squared trace error. At \(m=2\) reported error is always zero while actual error never is, and for every \(m\ge3\) expectation is too small by exact factor \(m+1\) despite absolute MSE tending to zero. Exact false-zero probability matters for interpreting adaptive stopping diagnostics and quantifies the issue beyond a cheap zero-test.
